claim: Account Factory can provision, update and enroll accounts concurrently, with up to 5 account-related operations in progress at once; unmanaging accounts must be done one account at a time. The concurrent account operations quota has a default of 5, is adjustable, and has a maximum of 10.

qualifiers.scope: concurrent account operations in Account Factory
qualifiers.condition: unmanaging accounts is one account at a time; the quota can be raised to a maximum of 10

evidence.quote: Accounts can be provisioned, updated, and enrolled concurrently in Account Factory, through an asynchronous process, with up to five (5) account-related operations in progress simultaneously. Unmanaging accounts must be performed one account at a time.

| Concurrent account operations quota | Each supported Region: 5 |  [Yes](https://console.aws.amazon.com/servicequotas/home/services/controltower/quotas/L-04D09B14)  | The maximum number of concurrent account operations that can be performed at the same time. Maximum: 10 |
